messages:
sophia: Heads-up: Tiny launch plan for partner NimbusNode listing. Were T-36h. Need owners for assets, SI validation, pricing, and legal quote.

ali: I can run SI validation. Slot today 18:00 UTC. Will need NimbusNode eng on call.

megan: Partner uploaded images but not retina. I can accept low-res for preview. Final must be 2x by cutover. Path: s3://nimbusnode/marketplace/3121/.

jordi: Ill take pricing band and marketplace metadata. Will update the pricing sheet and tag the listing.

infra-bot: preview-check started (job 12001)

ali: SI runbook:
```
- checkout release/nimbusnode
- deploy connector v1.3.7
- smoke: ./ci/smoke.sh --sku NIM-EDGE
- verify: tail -n 150 /var/log/redwood/connector.log | grep "handshake ok"
- upload logs to Partnerships/NimbusNode/tests
```
If firmware mismatch, fallback = publish listing with "integration pending" badge and disable deploy button.

megan: Legal wants a 1-sentence quote. I asked NimbusNode marketing; they said will send by tomorrow 09:00 PT.

jordi: Confirmed pricing band: Tier C. Updated marketplace metadata and price-band component. Ticket INF-8421 added for analytics to capture partner.sku.

sophia: Embargo is 2026-04-30T17:00:00Z. All public assets + legal signoff T-24h prior. If we have no blockers by 12:00 PT tomorrow we mark launch-ready and do a dry-run at 13:00 PT.

infra-bot: preview-check succeeded 44c no broken links detected

ali: Will post SI run results here after 18:00 UTC.

sophia: Thanks team 44d remember to document test results in Partnerships/Marketplace/NimbusNode/launch-playbook.md and tag approvals in the tracker.
